mapper.select:
select s.*, p.problem_title, u.username from submission s left join problem p on s.problem_id = p.problem_id left join user u on s.user_id = u.user_id
and (p.problem_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.username like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and s.status = #{status}
order by s.create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into submission (problem_id, user_id, title, content_file_id, status, total_score, submit_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{problemId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{contentFileId}, #{status}, #{totalScore}, now(), now(), now())
